params.topic: Serie A Italy eight-season historical bookmaker odds gap recovery for auditable Qimen Shadow research
questions: For Serie A seasons 2018/19 through 2025/26, identify public, verifiable row-level sources for Bet365, Pinnacle, and William Hill 1X2 and total-goals odds. The local inventory already has football-data I1 bulk files for 2021/22-2025/26; focus on the missing 2018/19-2020/21 seasons and confirm whether 2025/26 is complete or partial.

Keep bookmakers and markets separate. Preserve true opening, first-captured/pre-closing, and closing semantics as distinct fields. Never relabel football-data Friday/Tuesday pre-closing values as true opening, never infer opening from closing, and never substitute API-Football for bookmaker odds.

For every concrete row, require season, match date or kickoff timestamp, normalized home team, normalized away team, bookmaker, market, source URL or stable fixture identifier, field locator, fetched_at, and source hash. Return coverage, matched, unmatched, duplicate, conflict, unavailable, and blocked counts. Preserve unresolved rows with reasons.

Assess whether any source supports O_OPEN, O_CLOSE, or O_INTERVAL Shadow use. A same-bookmaker pre-closing-to-closing pair may be reported only as pre_closing_to_closing and is not a true opening-to-closing interval. Do not derive Qimen palace, Q/F/G/I/M tokens, model directions, scores, or predictions.

State whether each recovered record is sufficient for strict crosswalk to a local case_id and complete pre-match qimen_output.json. The output is evidence for the supplement ledger only and must not modify formal Snapshot, Outcome, Review, Gold, or the formal prediction search index. Return structured JSON with source URLs, field semantics, audit totals, conflicts, and unresolved_queue.
